subject: Conversation freeze: prolonged streaming stalls & SLA risk
content:
From: Alice Chen <alice@brightwell.health>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: urgent — intermittent conversation hang during clinician sessions

Hi Rafael,

We saw another major hit this morning: about 8 clinician sessions experienced a hard freeze in the middle of streaming completions. Clients report the UI shows 'waiting for response' and then a client-side timeout at ~20s, followed by rapid reconnect attempts that generated 429s. This started around 08:30 ET and affected one primary shard.

I'm attaching session logs and one screenshot of the stalled console. Can you confirm whether Redwood changed any streaming config or model variant this weekend? This is causing sync issues for our scheduled triage meeting tomorrow — we need an ETA.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director, Clinical Ops
Brightwell Health

Attachments: session_logs_20270418.tar.gz, screenshot_stall_20270418.png

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: urgent — intermittent conversation hang during clinician sessions

Alice — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I'm escalating this to infra/ops now. Preliminary note: we did not deploy a runtime change over the weekend to Brightwell's pinned model. However, we did roll a backend cache optimization across several regions; I'm asking Aditya to validate whether Brightwell's region or routing experienced a fallback to a different capacity tier.

Short answers you can expect within 2 hours:
- Initial triage (impact, shard, sample request IDs)
- Temporary mitigation (increase client keepalive, short-term routing to alternate pool)
- PM/CS sync time for a post-mortem and SLA note

We take this seriously — sorry for the disruption.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 18:15:41 -07:00
Subject: RE: urgent — intermittent conversation hang during clinician sessions

Folks — initial triage results below (quick bullet):
- Spike of 5xx+429 observed between 08:27-08:46 ET on pool-us-east-2a serving Brightwell workload.
- Root signature: a subset of streaming connections were entering an idle/half-closed state when network jitter caused gRPC keepalive to not be processed; the client then retried aggressively (5-8 retries in ~10s).
- Autoscaler reacted by spinning up additional warm endpoints but routing lag + connection churn led to transient overload on the target pool (amplified by prefix cache misses).
- No model change; no config rollout affecting compatibility.

Immediate mitigations applied at 18:02 PDT:
1) Enabled a short-term 3s ramp delay on our routing layer to smooth reconnections for the affected shard.
2) Increased the per-connection request token bucket to reduce 429s on short bursts.
3) Pinned Brightwell traffic to a broader pool to avoid single-shard hot spots.

I recommend the following customer-facing steps:
- Ask Brightwell to temporarily increase their client-side keepalive to 45s and backoff to 300ms to reduce retry storms.
- We will keep the routing ramp enabled for 48 hours and monitor for reoccurrence.

Logging: pushed a filtered set of session IDs to the incident page (see link).

Aditya
Sr. Engineer, Inference Ops

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:21:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent — intermittent conversation hang during clinician sessions

Alice — update from ops: we identified a connection-churn amplification loop that produced a short-lived 429/5xx spike. We applied several mitigations (routing ramp, token-bucket tuning, pool pinning). We also recommend a small client-side backoff and longer keepalive.

Can we schedule a 30-min call this afternoon (ET) to walk through the mitigation and next steps? Proposed slots: 13:00 ET, 15:00 ET. Rafael will be on the call and Aditya will join for the technical walkthrough.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
